name: Stinking Cloud

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: 20-foot sphere Heavy Obscurement; start-turn CON save or Poisoned through end of turn and no Action/Bonus Action; strong wind disperses; Concentration and source eligibility.

rules.text: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range.
The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind ) disperses it.
Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn.
While Poisoned in this way, the creature can’t take an action or a Bonus Action.
